headline.text: Metal stick found under L3 ML4 cleaning roller 1 during *overnight shift* — removed before startup, no product contact confirmed.

summary: One active metal-in-equipment event on L3 ML4, resolved before depositing resumed. L1 S1 metal detector faulted mid-shift without product passing; maintenance reset. L1 S2 inline magnet HACCP control flagged as not consistently followed.

holds.title: Underweight bags held without ID
holds.summary: Bin of underweight bags from 2nd shift found unidentified in L1 S1 area — QA investigating origin and disposition.
holds.status: Open — QA investigating reason bags were left without identification; disposition pending.

food_safety.title: Inline magnet HACCP control not followed
food_safety.summary: QA flagged inline magnet not installed on S2 at startup — HACCP plan requires inline magnet at all times during run.
food_safety.status: Resolved — scraper and inline magnet installed by 08:47 MT; line resumed production.

food_safety.title: Metal stick found under ML4 cleaning roller
food_safety.summary: Maintenance found metal stick under cleaning roller 1 during overnight shift before depositing started — no product contact, removed before line startup.
food_safety.status: Resolved — metal stick removed before depositing; no product at risk.

food_safety.title: Water particles in S1 metal detector container
food_safety.summary: QA found water particles inside metal detector collection container at 07:02 MT — source suspected to be residual moisture from 3rd shift cleaning, not active leak.
food_safety.status: Resolved — container emptied, scrapped; monitoring for recurrence; test cards passed after inspection.

food_safety.title: S1 metal detector faulting without product
food_safety.summary: Metal detector began opening at 09:03 MT with no product passing through — maintenance reset, no product was on line during fault period.
food_safety.status: Resolved — maintenance increased C1 speed to 50 and reset; line resumed 09:28 MT.

food_safety.title: Rusted chain found in ML1 almond system
food_safety.summary: Maintenance discovered old almond chain rusted out while locating master link — chain not in active use but present in food zone.
food_safety.status: Open — maintenance located issue; disposition of rusted chain not yet reported.

quality.title: Wrapped product found in S2 pre-op
quality.summary: Pre-op inspection found one wrapped chocolate on Matrix 6 top scale and two chocolates in window — no source identified.
quality.status: Open — QA and supervision investigating origin; Curt Willis, Justin Garner, Jody Howse notified.

quality.title: S4 wrapper producing double wraps and cut foil
quality.summary: THG wrapper producing double-wrapped pieces and misaligned/cut paper — production removing defects; root cause identified as piece height variance.
quality.status: Resolved — maintenance inspected; issue was caramel height variance, operators adjusted and monitoring closely.

sanitation.title: FEA roll contamination prevention protocol
sanitation.summary: FEA rolls being removed from protective bags before staging instead of at point of use — risk of contamination before installation.
sanitation.status: Open — supervisors notified; teams reminded rolls must remain bagged until machine loading.

sanitation.title: ML4 SWECO collection trays found dirty at shift start
sanitation.summary: Yellow collection trays under SWECO machines dirty at 3rd shift startup — 1st shift did not leave clean for next shift.
sanitation.status: Open — trays cleaned by 3rd shift; coaching needed for 1st shift on shift-end cleaning protocol.

sanitation.title: Unlabeled white bucket used for scrap
sanitation.summary: White bucket (unlabeled) found on stairs in S1 used for scrap — scrap buckets must be yellow and labeled per GMP.
sanitation.status: Resolved — bucket corrected immediately; supervisor Katya Farnsworth confirmed.

opportunities.text: Review S1 metal detector maintenance checklist for water ingress sources — today's moisture in collection container suggests cleaning protocol may need drying step or inspection point.
Add inline magnet verification to S2 startup checklist with photo requirement — today's HACCP control was missed at line start.
Review FEA roll staging procedures with MRCs — today's bagged-roll protocol violation suggests training gap on contamination prevention during material handling.
Consider adding post-cleaning verification to ML4 operator handoff checklist — today's dirty SWECO trays suggest shift-end cleaning not consistently completed.
